rationale: The assistant correctly identified the door interlock/latch as the most likely cause, gave the sensible first step (unplug, clean the hooks and latch slots, check closure) with an explicit boundary against opening the casing, and asked an answerable follow-up about latching. After the customer reported continued stops and a possible slight door drop, it escalated to an engineer without naming a part, which matches the ground truth. Minor weaknesses: it never asked about frequency/pattern relative to how gently the door is closed (a listed important unknown), did not mention Bosch service specifically despite the customer being willing to pay for a Bosch visit, and the closing fan/thermal speculation was slightly tangential given the door-reopen reset behaviour, though it did acknowledge the control-module-vs-switch uncertainty only implicitly.
